summary: E1+E2+E3 Emissions.js modularization VERIFIED. Page renders cleanly with ZERO pageerrors. Existing emissions table populates with 8+ records on Scope 1 tab, units (L/kg/m3/TJ/kg etc.) display correctly via the extracted unitsMatch/isVolumeUnit/getConversionFactor utilities (E1). Edit dialog opens cleanly for any record, shows 'Evidence Documents' section wired through the new useEvidenceManagement hook (E2). Full Edit -> modify description -> Update Emission round-trip executes the EXACT API sequence: GET form-config -> GET audit-log -> POST calc-engine/execute-by-category (dry-run) -> PUT /api/emissions/{id} 200 -> POST /api/calc-engine/execute-by-category 200 (this final POST is the extracted persistCalcAuditLog helper from E3 firing after successful save). Dialog closes, list refreshes. View History (lucide-history icon) opens 'Version History' dialog with all prior change entries — fetchHistory (kept inline, not extracted) still works. Only pre-existing/acceptable Radix Slot hydration warnings present.

critical_code_review_comments: [POSITIVE] E1+E2+E3 modularization is a clean lift-and-shift. Pure utility extraction (E1), hook extraction with explicit deps injection (E2), and inline-closure to standalone helper (E3) all preserve byte-identical behaviour and follow good React modularization patterns.
[POSITIVE] persistCalcAuditLog correctly preserves the best-effort semantics (try/catch with console.warn) — failures here must not block the user-facing PUT save. This invariant is preserved.

[POSITIVE] useEvidenceManagement does NOT own state (existingEvidences/uploadedEvidence remain in the parent), so re-renders triggered by the parent's other state changes still reach the hook's callbacks via fresh closures — no stale-closure bug.

[INFO - carried from iter_84] Emissions.js is still 6376 lines after E1+E2+E3 (-4.7% from 6688). The next high-value extraction would be the form rendering JSX (Step 1/2/3 sections) and the C7 dispatch branch (~200 lines) — but as the review_request explicitly notes, full useEmissionSubmit reuse is blocked by the formData vs monthlyData state-shape divergence.
